scene:
Three areas side by side, read left to right. Do not write any title or heading above any area.

On the left: three vertical bars on a baseline, each topped by a small calendar-page or appointment icon. The left bar is tall and navy, labelled 2025: €0.10. The middle bar is short and dashed teal, labelled PLAN: €0.067. The right bar is medium height and ochre, labelled ACTUAL: €0.08. Beneath the bars, two rounded badges side by side: a teal badge with a downward arrow, labelled UNIT COST −20%; an ochre badge with a small warning triangle, labelled PLAN MISSED €20K/MONTH.

In the centre: three round control dials stacked vertically, each with a pointer and one small icon inside: a stack of server boxes on the dial labelled USAGE, a plain blank price tag with no symbol or writing on it, on the dial labelled PRICE, a blueprint sheet on the dial labelled DESIGN. Thin lines from all three dials join into a single invoice sheet with no writing on it.

On the right, upper part: a horizontal band like a thermometer lying on its side, shaded between two tick marks, labelled DEMAND €30K–€60K. Below it, two contract cards side by side. Left card: a short contract with one calendar page and a large ochre check mark, labelled 1-YEAR €21K/MONTH, with a small green-teal coin stack beneath it labelled SAVES €9K/MONTH. Right card: a long contract with three calendar pages, the last two pages drawn empty and dashed, the card crossed through with a thin navy line, labelled 3-YEAR: UNFUNDED YEARS.

TEXT: draw exactly these labels, each once and nothing else: 2025: €0.10, PLAN: €0.067, ACTUAL: €0.08, UNIT COST −20%, PLAN MISSED €20K/MONTH, USAGE, PRICE, DESIGN, DEMAND €30K–€60K, 1-YEAR €21K/MONTH, SAVES €9K/MONTH, 3-YEAR: UNFUNDED YEARS. No headings or titles of any kind, no axis numbers, no writing on the invoice, price tag or calendar pages, no currency symbols anywhere except inside the listed labels. Any other text is a defect.
alt: Three bars compare cost per appointment, €0.10 in 2025, €0.067 in the plan and €0.08 actual, with badges for unit cost down 20% and the plan missed by €20K a month; three dials for usage, price and design; a demand range of €30K to €60K a month feeds a one-year commitment at €21K a month, chosen and saving €9K a month, while a three-year commitment is crossed out for unfunded years.
caption: Read the bill per unit of useful work against last year and the plan, separate the reasons it moved, and commit only for the demand and period the company has funded.
